oracle: h3.h3shape_to_cells (cell center inside the polygon; multipolygon = union of its polygons)

tolerances.cells: exact set equality per case, except the cells listed as ambiguous
tolerances.derivation: the GPU forms cell centers in float32 (ulp up to 1.5e-5 degrees at longitude 180, 7.6e-6 below 128), so a center within 1e-4 degrees (about 7 ulp) of the polygon boundary may fall on the other side. Those cells are listed as ambiguous; every other cell must match h3 in both directions. h3 sees the same float32 vertices as the GPU.
